protocol.question: Does restriction to an own-current-month NCut K10 group improve a five-peer forecast of the next spending change beyond unrestricted nearest peers, own seasonal history and SSE groups?
protocol.novelty: Predictive usefulness of historical peer changes; previous trajectory, confidence, same-month peer and cluster-stability tests did not score this temporal target.

reference.method: Separate explicit fit_reference12: median of the 12 month-specific median pairwise distances, unchanged physical blocks and distance arithmetic, observed support separately each calibration month.
reference.geometry: LHCLR alpha=0.5 beta=0.5; fixed 2023 reference for all current, historical and target coordinates
forbidden: duplicating calendar to satisfy old fit_reference guard

support.fit: All IDs observed at current origin t; no requirement that target t+1 exists.
support.query_and_peer_pool: mask[t] & mask[t-1] & mask[t-12] & mask[t-11], determined before target mask
support.future_scoring: Only after immutable predictions are saved, score predeclared queries observed at t+1. Report original query denominator, future missingness, prediction availability and scored denominator separately.

clustering.native_engine: Unchanged exact Lloyd/NCut/SpectralEngine primitives; dedicated K10 adapter, without changing old K-domain guards or calling the six-ICVI finish stage.
clustering.selection: Original own_representative: converged starts only, own exact objective minimum, scale/1e10 tolerance, canonical labels then seed_index. NCut scale K; SSE scale max(1,SST).

peers.distance: Euclidean in unchanged current X6, except LEVEL_NN5 uses absolute current logTotal difference
peers.tie_break: Exact dyadic squared distance then ascending numeric source ID; same deterministic rule for all peer methods
peers.fewer_than_five: typed unavailable, no fallback, no smaller k, no removal from registered denominator

prediction.seasonal_transition_for_origin_index_t: X[j,t-11] - X[j,t-12], with January2023 index0 and January2024 index12
prediction.peer_forecast: Mean of the selected five IDs' historical same-calendar 2023 transitions
prediction.global_seasonal_mean: Mean historical same-calendar transition across the predeclared peer pool excluding the query ID
prediction.implementation_separation: Persist source-bound predictions/peers before evaluator opens t+1 values or future availability; evaluation cannot return choices to fitting/prediction.

evaluation.primary_loss: Euclidean norm of predicted-minus-actual delta X6
evaluation.aggregation: Equal weight per scored ID within each origin, then equal weight for each of all 11 origins
evaluation.no_p_values: 11 overlapping origins are not independent replications; no retrospective significance claim
evaluation.missing_prediction: Any candidate prediction unavailable on an observed-target registered query makes complete-cohort joint success unavailable; conditional descriptive results separately labelled, no successful-subset verdict.
evaluation.zero_control_loss: Ratios null; use original multiplicative inequalities directly, never divide by zero

proposed_gate_requires_root_freeze_befor.each_primary_control: NCut mean-origin loss <= 0.99 * control loss AND for every origin NCut loss <= 1.05 * control loss
proposed_gate_requires_root_freeze_befor.additional_simple_control_guard_for_gene: NCut mean-origin loss must not exceed each of PERSISTENCE_ZERO, OWN_LAST_CHANGE, GLOBAL_SEASONAL_MEAN and LEVEL_NN5; otherwise at most a named-control-specific result, never generally best forecast.

compute.candidate_grid: one geometry, one K, one neighbor count, one horizon, original fixed eight seeds
compute.proposed_runtime: Reference stage plus fixed January/July pilots, then remaining nine origins on up to three single-thread workers; no outcome-based admission. Root supplies new explicit absolute deadline; suggested wall900s and reserve180s are proposals, not guarantees.
compute.resource_admission: After reference and the two included pilots: 2*max(pilot end-to-end seconds)*ceil(9/3)+180 must fit remaining wall and deadline. No automatic broader study if it passes.

required_synthetic_checks_before_executi: Changing any t+1 value or mask cannot alter a source-bound prediction, peer selection, current fit inputs or reference
Changing 2024 values cannot alter the 2023 reference
Never read future peer transitions; hand-computable seasonal transfer fixture
Self exclusion, exact distance ties, scarce peer groups and missing targets remain explicit
Source ID/label permutation invariance and all11 aggregation
Own-seasonal, persistence and own-last baselines match direct hand calculations
limits: Retrospective algorithmically past-only backtest; the historical panel has already been inspected in earlier research, so it is not an untouched holdout.
Published nominal resident spending, not income, transaction-flow truth, causal impact, inflation adjustment or independently collected external Y.
Historical data revision/publication lags are not documented here; no claim of a point-in-time deployable forecast before actual source publication.
The preceding calendar year's peer dynamics may not transfer; a negative result is informative and does not change frozen cluster roles.
Prediction improvement would support this bounded analog-selection use case only, not superior overall clustering or competitor ranking.

accepted_gate.each_primary_control: NCut mean-origin loss <= 0.99 * control loss AND for every origin NCut loss <= 1.05 * control loss
accepted_gate.additional_simple_control_guard_for_gene: NCut mean-origin loss must not exceed each of PERSISTENCE_ZERO, OWN_LAST_CHANGE, GLOBAL_SEASONAL_MEAN and LEVEL_NN5; otherwise at most a named-control-specific result, never generally best forecast.

additional_descriptive_outputs: fraction of exact peer-set equality against GLOBAL_X6_NN5
loss and coverage by current NCut group; never replaces primary aggregation
root_decision.scientific_scope: One algorithmically past-only retrospective seasonal peer backtest; same published spending source; not a point-in-time historical data vintage or untouched holdout.

operations.reason: Finalize deadline only after frozen source, synthetic verification and VM staging are ready.
